summary: Comprehensive testing of Handbooks & Documents Upload System. All features working correctly - file upload to object storage, download functionality, CRUD operations, search/filter, role-based permissions.
seed_data_creation: Test documents created and cleaned up during pytest run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Handbooks & Documents upload system fully tested and working. Uses Emergent object storage (not mocked). Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_document_upload.py

verified_features.feature: Handbooks page loads and shows uploaded handbooks with file details
verified_features.details: Page shows handbook cards with title, category badge, file name, file size, description, Download button

verified_features.feature: Upload Handbook button opens modal with drag-and-drop zone, title, category, description fields
verified_features.details: Modal has dropzone ('Drop a file here or click to browse'), Title (required), Category dropdown, Description field, Content textarea (if no file)

verified_features.feature: Search bar filters handbooks by title/description
verified_features.details: Search input filters handbooks list, empty state shows 'No matching handbooks' when no results

verified_features.feature: Category filter dropdown works to filter handbooks
verified_features.details: Category dropdown has All Categories, SOPs, Training Guides, Cadet Handbook, Staff Handbook, Regulations, References, Other options

verified_features.feature: Edit button opens edit modal with pre-filled data
verified_features.details: Edit modal shows with pre-filled Title, Category, Description, Content fields and Save Changes button

verified_features.feature: Download button works - clicking it downloads the file
verified_features.details: Download button visible on handbook cards, backend download endpoint tested and working (content matches upload)

verified_features.feature: Delete button removes a handbook after confirmation
verified_features.details: Delete button visible on hover, backend DELETE endpoint tested and verified with GET returning 404

verified_features.feature: Official Documents page loads and shows documents with type badges
verified_features.details: Page shows document cards with title, type badge (OTHER, Official Document, etc.), description

verified_features.feature: Upload Document button opens modal with doc type selector
verified_features.details: Modal has dropzone, Title, Document Type dropdown (Official Document, Form/CAPF, Reference, Checklist, Regulation/Policy, Other)
All Types filter dropdown visible and functional

verified_features.feature: Backend API: POST /api/documents/upload creates document with file in object storage
verified_features.details: 13 pytest tests passed - uploads create documents with storage_path, file_name, file_size, file_type fields

verified_features.feature: Backend API: GET /api/documents/{id}/download returns the file
verified_features.details: Download endpoint returns file content with correct Content-Type and Content-Disposition headers

verified_features.feature: Backend API: GET /api/documents returns list with new file fields
verified_features.details: Documents list includes storage_path, file_name, file_size, file_type for uploaded files
Commander role (ldivers@cap.gov) can see Upload button and successfully upload documents

test_classes: TestDocumentUploadAPI - Upload handbook/document with file to object storage
TestDocumentDownloadAPI - Download files from object storage, round-trip verification
TestDocumentListAPI - List documents includes file fields
